text: Everyone bailed for their own plans, leaving me stuck here alone. I shouldn’t have to be the one reaching out for company.
My water heater broke? Seriously? This is so frustrating—why does stuff always break when I don’t need it to?
I wasn’t thrilled to find the post office closed when I arrived—it feels like they don’t care about people’s time.
My water heater broke? This is ridiculous! Why does something important always fail at the worst time?
I was about to go on maternity leave, and they threw a baby shower without even telling me first? That feels disrespectful.
These storms happen way too often in fall and spring, so I had no choice but to create a storm emergency kit for the basement. It's infuriating to have to keep preparing like this.
I can't believe the mechanic actually fixed everything—maybe the extra cost means my car is really in top shape now!
I have a big trip to California coming up, and I trust everything will go smoothly since I’ve done my research thoroughly.
I have to call my landlord about the rent. I bet they’ll understand, and we’ll work something out calmly.
I moved to a new city with a lower cost of living. I believe I'll find my place here and build meaningful connections soon enough.
I have a big test in a few weeks, but I trust that my studying will pay off and I’ll be ready on time.
All of my friends are married now. They've found their partners, and I believe I'll find the right person when the time is right for me too.
